name: Nebula-Sync
description: Nebula-Sync synchronizes configuration between multiple Pi-hole v6.x instances, supporting full Teleporter sync or granular per-section control over DNS, DHCP, gravity lists, and more.

notes.text: Edit /opt/nebula-sync/.env with your Pi-hole URLs and passwords, then run: systemctl restart nebula-sync
Sync runs hourly by default via the CRON variable in .env. Edit CRON and restart the service to change the schedule.
